title: VisionImageRequest
description: vision.image-request@1: one image for OpenVibe.Vision's one-shot tools, as a data URL or a public URL. The multipart form field `image` carries the same bytes. Private tools (find, index, watch, moments) accept only uploaded bytes or a data URL, never an unverified source URL.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
